method: Frozen finish_review validated a materialized copy of the immutable final screen snapshot in an isolated audit workspace; its hard-coded analysis/quality destination was not used inside the active campaign. All screen fields, packet, objective results and private mapping copied exactly; only source audit and summary generated.
scope: Final screening only. Confirmation is active and has no completed source audit; final all-phase cap inventory remains pending. Selected sample includes every automatic failure and capped response, so counts are not population error/usefulness rates. No timing or acquisition changes and no quality-equivalence claim.
